title: AI Interviews
summary: Structured video, voice and coding interviews scored on a consistent rubric.
headline: Interviews that *don't wait* for calendars
lede: Structured first-round interviews run whenever the candidate is ready. Each one is transcribed, time-stamped and scored on the rubric your panel agreed, then handed to a recruiter to decide.

capabilities.title: Automated Video Interviews
capabilities.body: Candidates answer the same structured questions on camera, on a laptop or a phone, with nothing to install.
points: Same questions, same order, for every candidate
Works in the browser on any device

capabilities.title: Voice-Based Interviews
capabilities.body: Phone-style interviews for roles where the voice is the job, such as contact centre and field roles.
points: Language and clarity assessed against the role

capabilities.title: Conversational AI Interviews
capabilities.body: An interviewer that listens and asks sensible follow-up questions, staying inside the topics your panel approved.
points: Follow-ups drawn from the candidate’s own answers
Stays within your approved question plan
Candidates can ask about the role and process

capabilities.title: Coding Interviews
capabilities.body: A live editor with real test cases, where the candidate’s reasoning is captured as well as the final code.
points: Runs code against hidden and visible tests
Playback of how the solution was reached
Supports the common languages and frameworks

capabilities.title: Proctoring & Monitoring
capabilities.body: Integrity checks that flag unusual activity for a person to review. A flag alone never fails a candidate.
points: Tab switches, second voices and screen sharing flagged
Every flag reviewed by a human before any action
Candidates told up front what is monitored

capabilities.title: Interview Analytics
capabilities.body: Transcript, waveform and rubric scores in one view, so a panel can check the evidence in minutes.
points: Jump from a score to the moment it came from
Skills radar calibrated to the role profile
Compare finalists on the same criteria

outcomes.label: interviews processed a year across 40 countries
interview languages, with the same scoring in each
installs needed on laptop or phone
